About.title: About Me
About.p1: I am a Front-end Engineer passionate about building accessible, pixel-perfect user interfaces that merge thoughtful design with robust engineering. I thrive at the intersection of creativity and code, crafting experiences that are not only visually appealing but also meticulously engineered for performance and usability.
About.p2: Currently, I work as a Front-End Engineer at <link>DataMasterDZ</link>, where I develop a modern ERP system to streamline business operations.
About.p3: In my role, I focus on creating intuitive user interfaces and ensuring a seamless user experience across the application.
About.p4: I am committed to continuous learning and staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends and best practices.
About.p5: In my free time, I enjoy exploring new technologies and working on personal projects that challenge my skills and creativity.

project1.name: Project One
project1.description: Video course that teaches how to build a web app with the Spotify Web API. Topics covered include the principles of REST APIs, user auth flows, Node, Express, React, Styled Components, and more.

project2.name: Project Two
project2.description: A web app that allows users to search for and view animated GIFs from the Giphy API. Features include search suggestions, trending GIFs, and the ability to favorite and download GIFs.

exp1.name: DataMasterDZ
exp1.description: Developed and maintained the front-end of a comprehensive ERP system using React, Redux, and Tailwind CSS. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and implement user-friendly interfaces, ensuring seamless integration with back-end services. Focused on performance optimization and responsive design to enhance user experience across various devices.

exp2.name: Freelance Web Developer
exp2.description: Worked with clients to create custom websites and web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and popular frameworks like React and Vue.js. Managed all aspects of the development process, from initial consultation and design to deployment and maintenance. Delivered high-quality, responsive, and SEO-optimized solutions tailored to client needs.
